notes.subject: mahu
notes.rationale: הבל ka botlalo ke 'moya wa meno/mophutho' — sephethwana se se fofago; 'mahu' (se se se nago selo) ke bofsa bja seswantšho, phethego ya moya e lahlegile.

notes.subject: הבל הבלים
notes.rationale: Poeletšo ya botsu bja Seheberu (Hebrew superlative: 'mahu ya dimahu' = mahu kudu go feta mahu ka moka); go anwa ga mokgwa wo ka ntle ga dikarata tše hlano mo temaneng e tee.

notes.subject: ⟨ke⟩
notes.rationale: Sepedi e nyaka kopula; Seheberu se e hloka — 'hakol havel' ga se na kerewe ya 'ke'.

translation: Mahu, mahu a dimahu, go bolela Khelete; mahu, mahu a dimahu — ⟨ke⟩ mahu ka moka.
